title: Beyond Field Accuracy: Two-Axis Diagnosis of Inverse-PINN Parameter Error
summary: Inverse physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can reconstruct a field accurately while returning an incorrect physical parameter. We introduce a two-axis post-training diagnosis that separates finite-sample resolution under a specified observation-and-estimation protocol from the signed parameter preference encoded by the final learned field and residual metric. The first axis repeatedly fits noisy observations with a matched forward estimator. At known synthetic truth, the second freezes the field and residual view and computes a local score displacement toward a nearby residual-profile…
